summary: Added docshelf/access.py with the public names from docs/access.md. All six commands now call it with their own module-level RULES, and the access checks are gone from them. The 30 tests pass (including the new tests/test_access.py), and about 40,000 random commands on odd workspaces matched the original package in output, exit status and workspace files. Existing quirks are kept as they were and not fixed: the command copies disagree on role case, suspension days, grant and delegation ends, blank teams, `*` grants and delegates. The share and delete RULES fields blank_team, wildcard_admin and (for delete) ends are never read by those commands.
